item.title: Editorial: Happy New Year From Nintendo Life
item.description: '26 mix.Good news, everyone! No need to bother with all that GOTY rigmarole next year, as it's already wrapped and bagged. Commiserations to the losers, and congratulations to Rhythm Heaven Groove! Catch you all again in '27...Okay, okay.
